patterns.what_worked: The shaman's apply_family_slots precedent (re-point guide.slots AFTER the guide frame built its icons) is the seam that carries the common abilities into the practice panel without touching the live guide - it needed no change to the practice engine and left every other lane's suite (guide_contract's slot-count pins, paladin_state) untouched. Resolving the abilities by the client's English spell NAME (the rogue's resolve_named_spell rule) made the per-family id split unnecessary at runtime while the cited ids stay the citation and the locale fallback.
patterns.what_was_hard: The panel's ability list is only reachable through module.guide.slots and practice_rotation_for - both of which other lanes pin (guide_contract's 12-slot paladin pin, the class suites' rotation slices). The closed-list contract also forced a definition of 'rotation action' vs 'panel entry', and the engine's family-scoped neutral publish reads st.family only - so the SoD build (which shares the Era family token with the Era build) cannot have a neutral key that is a rotation action on the Era build.
patterns.skill_gap: The id sourcing needed a corpus with NAMES (the local wow.export CSVs carry no spell-name column), so every id had to be paired with a name lookup on the operator-provided spell pages - a scripted one-line-per-id loop was worth building early.
